title: Listening to MS: AI-assisted speech analysis for diagnosis and fatigue prediction (COMMITMENT).
summary: Prospective speech recordings from 50 relapsing-MS patients and 20 controls were analyzed for fatigue and case status; leave-one-speaker-out models showed specificity 0.68–0.94 but lower sensitivity (0.38–0.90), and case/control sensitivity was 0.30 at specificity 0.90. This is exploratory speech-biomarker evidence, not a diagnostic test.
ai_technology: Automated speech-feature extraction and ML models classify MS/control status and regress fatigue ratings.
